title: Paloma Rewards Days in the Cash Pickup Correction Guarantee
content:
**Paloma Rewards programme note.** When a recipient name is corrected on a Cash Pickup transfer, Paloma Rewards members receive days in the correction guarantee. The correction guarantee is the number of days of collection the correction guarantees the recipient. The days follow the tier of the sender's Paloma Rewards membership whose status is active.

| Sender's active Paloma Rewards tier | Days added to the correction guarantee |
|---|---|
| Paloma Rewards Gold, Paloma Rewards Platinum, Paloma Rewards Diamond or Paloma Rewards Elite | 10 |
| Paloma Rewards Blue or Paloma Rewards Silver | 5 |
| no active membership | none |

Hypothetical: an active Paloma Rewards Elite member receives 10 days. An active Paloma Rewards Silver member receives 5. A sender whose membership is not active receives none.
